about.intro_location_text: Our warehouse operates in compliance with GDP requirements, where we store and consolidate our shipments. When the product requires temperature-controlled handling, we coordinate storage and transport to suit its specified conditions.
about.warehouse_heading: OSTA Trading GmbH is registered as a distributor of active substances in EudraGMDP under registration number DE_SH_01_Reg_2024_0003
about.intro_text_1: At OSTA Trading GmbH we combine our decades of professional experience in pharmaceutical industry and established network of international manufacturers, to create every opportunity for you to succeed. We tailor our services to your needs to save your time and your costs.
about.intro_text_2: Whether you require a product for an established commercial project or you are searching for a new product for your developing project, our highly experienced team will assist you with any request, guaranteeing to offer high-quality products at competitive prices. Our promise is to provide you with professional pharmaceutical distribution, international sourcing and reliable logistics.
about.about_title:
We aim to evolve along with you
to meet your requirements
about.intro_lead: OSTA Trading GmbH is a specialised distributor of active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs), excipients and specialty ingredients for the pharmaceutical, food and cosmetics industries.
about.tile_industries: We offer products across pharmaceutical and food industries
about.services_text_1: We deliver our best. Starting with your first inquiry through to commercial production, our team takes pride in supporting you at every stage of the supply process. From manufacturer and product sourcing, to providing logistics solutions, temperature-controlled storage and regulatory support. Thanks to our expertise and experience inside the pharmaceutical market, we built an established network of manufacturers across Europe and worldwide. This allows us to offer flexible solutions that are tailored to each of your project's individual technical, regulatory and commercial requirements.
about.services_text_2: The established manufacturer network gives us a basis for negotiating the competitive prices and finding alternatives when costs and availability change. We always consider all the practical terms of supply for our clients. From the prices and minimum order quantities to the lead times and frequency of your deliveries, we will do everything to meet your production needs.
about.people_robert_quote: “Our aim is to provide competitive prices and long-term supply for our clients.”
about.people_olga_quote: “We take our time to listen to you, in order to find the best solution.”
about.closing_title: Professionalism, reliability and long-term cooperation are at the centre of everything we do
about.closing_desc: Our knowledgeable and resourceful team will always assist you to find the answer you look for.

about.quality_text: We work closely with manufacturers and our logistics partners to uphold the agreed specifications, to maintain batch traceability and to meet your requirements throughout the whole supply process.

about.logistics_text: Your next project may need a product that is hard-to-find or one with specific restrictions for your market of interest. Our team is experienced in navigating different markets requirements and restrictions to bring you the result that you need.

services.hero_sub:
At OSTA Trading GmbH, our services extend beyond
just the distribution of APIs and excipients
services.hero_image_alt: Truck loading at the gate of a warehouse
services.process_title: We identify suitable manufacturers, coordinate necessary regulatory documentation, provide samples to you and manage your stock and logistics
services.process_text: This approach allows us to supply and distribute established products in our portfolio, but also as a sourcing partner when developing any new projects or looking for alternative sources for existing products.
services.process_map_label: Four stages from request to regular supply
services.supply_title: A fully qualified GDP warehouse guarantees reliable and individual storage for the products
services.how_title: As your partner it is our responsibility to follow through
services.how_text: Working with manufacturers across different markets and products takes persistence, time and coordination. We will take care of that work for you, providing you with informed decisions and arrangements that are tailored to your business.
services.how_step_1_text: Our aim is to give one point of contact for all your products, orders, documentation and shipments. When your priorities, requirements or schedules change, we will adapt and offer you direct solutions. When you require help we are one team to turn to.
services.how_step_2_text: Your manufacturing requirements and product purchasing quantities may all have different schedules. We are here to bridge that gap, allowing you to receive your products at your time and your terms. Combine all your orders into one consignment, or move products sooner or later. We adapt to your decision.
services.how_step_3_text: Whether you are expanding into another market, broadening your portfolio or adding a new production line, bring us a project so we can have a source in place. Tell us what you need, so we can draw on our knowledge of products and manufacturers, to lead you to the product that meets all your requirements and use our expertise to establish supply chain around it with your next stage of growth in mind.
services.how_step_4_text: The regulatory requirements of pharmaceutical industry are complex and constantly evolving. It is challenging to be up to date on the knowledge and amendments in the field. We draw on a decade of experience in tackling these exact issues for a decade and a half, and we continually pass through all the regulatory challenges. Our team is ready to do everything that is needed for your product to succeed.
services.closing_title:
We would love
to hear your challenge
services.closing_desc: Our knowledgeable and resourceful team will help you find the answer you are looking for.
services.manufacturer_card: Our team combines our scientific and market understanding with our hands-on experience to help you select, apply and search for specialty ingredients that are right for you. Committed to go beyond what is offered in our portfolio, we guarantee to find and source products you require.
services.regulatory_card: Before you commit to order, we will arrange samples for laboratory testing or trial quantities for broader-scale testing any time they are required. All our samples will always be accompanied by the appropriate documentation.
services.samples_card: We offer temperature-controlled storage and transportation tailored to your products' requirements along with efficient logistics to reduce lead times and the full traceability of supply chain. Our aim is to optimise your costs and accelerate the time to market of your products.
services.specs_card: Here to help you identify all the documentation you need to ship to your specific market and manage customs procedures for your shipments. We also guarantee to assist in resolving any quality complaints, whether for investigation or recall.
services.supply_text_1: Our job is keeping you supplied. We at OSTA Trading GmbH coordinate the supply chain from the procurement of your product straight to your destination, taking into consideration the product's specific handling requirements, as well as handling all the documentation and transport requirements applicable to your specific product. Including temperature-controlled storage and transportation.
services.supply_text_2: Our aim is to ensure that our supply is in line with your demand. Our supply arrangements will be adjusted to your forecasts, if you require the safety stock it can be agreed upon. OSTA's experienced team is quite familiar with the requirements and limitations that have to be met when working with pharmaceutical and other chemical products in various markets, so we can open the supply of hard-to-find products or tackle certain market restrictions for you.
services.row_title: Expertise and competence in developing pharmaceutical supply chains

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.intro: Short answers about ordering from OSTA Trading GmbH: availability, quotation requests, documentation, samples, EudraGMDP and GDP, and delivery. Need more detail? Our team will answer your specific request.
faq.q1: What does OSTA Trading GmbH do?
faq.a1: OSTA Trading GmbH is a specialised distributor of active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs), excipients and specialty ingredients for the pharmaceutical, food and cosmetics industries. Our warehouse is in Reinbek, in the Hamburg metropolitan area, and we supply customers across Europe and worldwide.
faq.q2: Which product groups do you offer?
faq.a2: Our catalogue covers APIs, excipients and food grade ingredients. Browse the product catalogue or search by name.
faq.q3: What does “in stock” or “sourcing on request” mean?
faq.a3: Products marked in stock are listed in our catalogue as available. Products marked sourcing on request are not kept in stock: we source them for you from suitable manufacturers. You can request either kind by sending an inquiry.
faq.q4: How do I request a quotation?
faq.a4: Open a product page and use the quotation button, or use the contact form and choose “Request a quote (RFQ)”. Tell us the application, specification, target market, regulatory requirements and expected volumes.
faq.q5: Can you find a product that is not in your catalogue?
faq.a5: Yes. If a product is not in our portfolio, we run a dedicated search for suitable manufacturers, matched to the technical, quality, regulatory and commercial requirements of your project.
faq.q6: Which documents and quality information can I get?
faq.a6: We coordinate the regulatory documentation your project requires and agree specifications and quality requirements with you and the manufacturer before supply starts. The documents available depend on the product and the manufacturer: ask our team about your position.
faq.a7: Yes. We arrange samples for your evaluation and support you up to qualification.
faq.q8: Are you registered in EudraGMDP and do you work to GDP?
faq.a8: OSTA Trading GmbH is registered in EudraGMDP as an API distributor, and our warehouse operates in compliance with GDP requirements.
faq.a9: We coordinate supply from the manufacturer to your destination, including international transport, import and export procedures and shipping documents, together with experienced logistics partners. Our warehouse in Reinbek lets us consolidate supplies and keep stock for selected products.
faq.q10: Are prices shown on the website?
faq.a10: No. Prices and terms depend on the product, quantity and delivery, so they are agreed individually. Send us a request and our manager will get back to you.
